brief:
Gaza's government media office accused Israeli forces of completely abandoning all commitments under the ceasefire agreement, Shehab Wire reported. The office documented 5,147 violations of the accord over the past year.

The allegations mark a sharp escalation in rhetoric surrounding the ceasefire's implementation, though the statement did not specify the nature of the claimed breaches or the timeframe of the documented violations.

title: Gaza says Israel breached ceasefire accord 5,147 times in past year
